'''Corellian Personal Defense''' was a manufacturing company that was based on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. The corporation manufactured and marketed the [["Big Shock"]] and [[Shock glove/Legends|shock glove]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] add-ons.
